data.body: **P2:** This gate is tied only to `close()`, which `DurableExecutor` reaches after constructing the result and firing `onInvocationEnd`. A continuation that passes this check just before closing can run another predicate/checkpoint during or after invocation-end hooks and OTel flushing, so plugins receive operation/user-function events after their end hook and the final snapshot omits completed work. Add a pre-finalization barrier that marks closing and drains continuations/running handlers before constructing `InvocationEndInfo`; fire `onInvocationEnd` only afterward, then shut down checkpointing.
